newsitem.title: USA: Motorola to expand digital cellular network.
newsitem.headline: Motorola to expand digital cellular network.

text.p: Motorola Inc said its International Cellular Infrastructure Group signed a contract to expand the digital cellular network in the United Arab Emirates.

As part of the expansion with cellular operator Etisalat, Motorola will supply its new flexible M-Cell Global System for Mobile Communications base stations and will provide technical support for the network.
The expansion project is scheduled for completion by year-end 1997 and once completed, will provide additional subscriber capacity in the northern Emirates of the United Arab Emirates.
The value of the contract was not disclosed.
